description.en: Follow-up capsules below each completed answer, generated from the answer text and sent as ordinary messages on click; a reusable message-template row above the composer with per-template fill-or-send behavior, live sync across pages, and an agent management tool.
description.zh: 每轮回答完成后在回答下方生成 1–3 条锚定正文、用户口吻的追问胶囊，点击即作为普通消息发送；输入框上方提供常用消息模板行，每条模板可设「填入输入框」或「直接发送」，同一 Host 的多页面实时同步，Agent 可用 message_templates 工具管理。
